description: Build an unsigned Aave V3 withdraw transaction. Pass `amount: "max"` to withdraw the entire aToken balance.

amount.description: Human-readable decimal amount of `asset`, NOT raw wei/base units. Example: "1.5" for 1.5 USDC, "0.01" for 0.01 ETH. Pass "max" for full-balance withdraw/repay.

name: prepare_aave_withdraw
